title: Renewal After Rollover to the Monthly Index Plan — Commercial Natural Gas Supply
content:
When a business accepts a renewal offer after its Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement has rolled over to the monthly index plan and within the post-expiry grace period, the agreement takes the offered plan and its term, and its contract rate per therm is the renewed price rather than the offered price as printed; the new term starts on the acceptance date. A renewal accepted after the agreement has rolled over earns no renewal loyalty credit.

## When the renewed price is fixed

The renewed price is not fixed until the agreement's most recently posted swing shortfall line, when its billed amount is above the correct shortfall amount and its correction lookback has not ended, carries its own rebill credit.

## Effect of the acceptance at a glance

| Term of the agreement | After the acceptance |
|---|---|
| Plan | The plan offered |
| Term | The offered plan's term |
| Contract rate per therm | The renewed price, not the printed offer price |
| First day of the new term | The acceptance date |
| Renewal loyalty credit | None |

## The acceptance tool: `accept_bizgas_lapsed_renewal_f259b0f9`

**Capability.** Through `accept_bizgas_lapsed_renewal_f259b0f9` the business's authorized representative accepts, in person, a renewal offer on a Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas agreement that has already rolled over to the month-to-month index plan. One call replaces the rolled-over terms on the agreement record with the renewed term (the plan, its term, the renewed price per therm, the contracted annual volume and the last day of the new term) and records today's date as the first day of that term. No credit line is booked. Afterwards the agreement shows the renewed fixed plan, price and end date in place of the index plan.

**Hand-over.** This is a tool the customer themselves runs. The care agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` under the name `accept_bizgas_lapsed_renewal_f259b0f9`, which hands it to the business; the authorized representative then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, using the exact tool name and argument values the agent gives.

**Parameters.**

- `bizgas_agreement_id` — the commercial gas agreement number of the site being renewed, as read to the representative from the agreement record by the care agent. Identifier, text.
- `offered_variant_name` — the plan named in the renewal offer being accepted, exactly one of: Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index (the offer renews onto the month-to-month index plan); Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 (the twelve-month plan with the basis locked and NYMEX floating); Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 (the twelve-month all-in fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 (the twenty-four-month all-in fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 (the thirty-six-month all-in fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 (the twenty-four-month fixed plan with full carbon offsets).
- `term_months` — the length of the renewed term in integer months, as published for the offered plan; 0 only for a month-to-month plan.
- `contract_rate_usd_therm` — the renewed price per therm the care agent quoted, in US dollars per therm, 4 decimal places, rounded half up.
- `contract_annual_therms` — the contracted annual volume of the renewed term, in integer therms.
- `new_contract_end_date` — the last day of the renewed term, written YYYY-MM-DD; no time zone.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `status` (the literal "renewed" when the renewal was recorded), `bizgas_agreement_id` (the renewed agreement's number), `variant_name` (the plan now in force), `contract_rate_usd_therm` (the renewed price per therm, 4 decimal places), `plan_change_date` (today's date as the first day of the renewed term, YYYY-MM-DD) and `contract_end_date` (the renewed term's last day, YYYY-MM-DD).
